defectClass: S321 generator-range defect: variant.gen range excludes the authored, hard-coded target
fixApplied: ch1's target (11, authored as 'the SMALLEST teen number') is a unique, load-bearing mathematical fact that cannot be reassigned to any other value without making the prose/answer false. The base-ten-build generator's default form draws its target via pick(rand, 12, lo ? 16 : 19) (src/lib/variants.ts ~line 6471), which is mathematically incapable of ever producing 11 (its range floor is 12). Re-anchoring the step to a generator-producible value was rejected because it would falsify the 'smallest teen' claim for every value in {12..19}. Removed the variant field ({gen: 'base-ten-build'}) from ch1 so this authored, hard-coded step is never subject to regeneration/replay drift; i1 and i2 in this same lesson already carry no variant key, so this is an established in-file pattern, not a new one. No other field changed.
justification: Removed variant key rather than re-anchoring: '11 = the smallest teen number' is a unique mathematical fact, not an arbitrary example the generator's producible range {12..19} could substitute for.
